title: 选做法之前，先了解谁设计、谁操作
title_en: Who designs your brows, and who performs the work?
intro: 同样的工具，设计和操作可能不同。选之前，可以把作品、设计思路和实际操作者放在一起看。
intro_en: The same tools can be used with different design and technical approaches. Review the work, design reasoning and the person who will perform the procedure together.

sections.title: 看完整的脸，也看细节
sections.title_en: Look at the whole face and the detail
sections.description: 先看眉形与五官是否协调，再放大看线条的间距、走向与衔接。照片是否说明恢复时间，也会影响你能从中判断什么。
sections.description_en: Look first at the relationship between brows and facial features, then examine stroke spacing, direction and transitions. Whether the healing stage is documented also affects what a photograph can tell you.

sections.title: 问设计依据
sections.description: 设计前，会综合观察五官的立体度、量感和整体风格，以及颧骨、眉眶骨的高低、眉眼关系和原生眉毛的生长方向。在尊重原有骨骼结构的基础上，通过调整眉头、眉峰、眉尾的位置、弧度与整体轮廓，修饰面部视觉比例，协调颧骨与眉眼之间的关系，让面部线条看起来更加流畅、舒展，并呈现更自然的立体感与折叠感。
sections.description_en: Before designing, she considers the depth, visual weight and overall character of the features, the height and prominence of the cheekbones and brow bone, the relationship between brows and eyes, and the direction of the existing brow hairs. Working with the existing bone structure, she adjusts the position and curvature of the brow start, arch and tail, along with the overall contour, to refine facial proportions visually and balance the relationship between the cheekbones and eye area. The aim is a smoother, more open visual flow, with natural depth and definition between facial planes.

sections.title: 确认实际操作者
sections.description: 描眉画目由乐乐老师本人一对一设计操作。2016年进入纹绣行业，2024年8月创立工作室；此前有连锁机构工作与纹绣培训、讲师经历。
sections.description_en: At Miaomeihuamu, Lele personally designs and performs the work, one client at a time. She entered the field in 2016 and opened the studio in August 2024, following work in beauty and specialist brow chains as well as training and teaching experience.
